info.title: UpDish hackathon business API
info.description: Core business contract. Web BFF maps /api/workbench/* to /api/v1/workbench/*. Every write also requires an exact allowed Origin. Auth and public GIWA diagnostic APIs are documented in wallet-guide.md. Bojagi always returns 503 until an official integration is available.
